Author: Aki
Name: StockTracker
Punchline: Know which retainer listings sold and need to be recrafted.
Description: Maintain a list of items you craft and sell through your retainers, each with a target restock quantity and an assigned retainer. StockTracker watches your retainers' current market listing quantities (via Allagan Tools, if installed) and automatically builds a 'needs recraft' list whenever a tracked item's retainer stock drops below its target - clearing it again once you restock. Commands: /stocktracker, /st. Requires Allagan Tools (InventoryTools).
